name: webhook-url-input
title: Webhook URL Input
description: Webhook URL field that judges the URL for its environment (ngrok, tunnel, localhost or private IP is an error in production, a hint in test), flags staging hosts, plain http and missing paths, and diffs against the last saved URL to catch www or trailing-slash-only changes.

meta.summary: Judges a webhook URL for the environment it's saved to and warns when an edit only changed www or a trailing slash, which senders treat as a failed redirect.
meta.server: Resolve and validate webhook targets server-side (block private ranges and metadata IPs) to prevent SSRF.
catches: Tunnel, localhost, private-IP and cloud-metadata hosts (error in production, hint in test)
Public request inspectors where anyone can read the payloads
Plain http and a missing path, with fixes
Edits that only change www or a trailing slash, with a one-tap revert
limits: Hostname rules only; it does not resolve DNS or send a request
Tunnel and inspector lists are starter sets
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid on errors and notes via aria-describedby
Notes in a polite live region with icon and text
After a fix, focus returns to the input
